catalyst_focus.method: Cross-reference positive-direction STOCK research candidates with SEC/FDA primary publication links and independent RVOL. A filing and an RVOL spike are clues, not proof of positive price reaction.

important: No retrospective outcome or profitability is inferred from the appearance of a research row.
